title: Video of Townsend Brown celebrating at UNC Chapel Hill
place_text: University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill

tellings.quote: There are even videos of Townsen Brown at the University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill, celebrating because his experiments presumably worked.

plain: Townsend Brown was an American researcher who, in the 1950s, experimented with devices he hoped could work against gravity. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are videos of Brown at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill celebrating, presumably because his experiments had worked. He tells it as a hint that Brown believed he had made a real breakthrough.
